title: Search for rare wild whooping cranes
description: Take a guided birdwatching boat from the Rockport area toward the cranes' coastal winter habitat. Their rarity and conservation story add meaning to the encounter.
teaser: Take a guided birdwatching boat from the Rockport area toward the cranes' coastal winter habitat.
goodToKnow: Ask about boat boarding and sea conditions. Wild whooping crane sightings cannot be promised.
